Messages.Author: Bordo101
Messages.Body:
Is obedience playable by a blocking vampire? It says usable by a vampire
entering combat with a younger vampire, but since it is a reaction card, is it
played before the vampire is tapped for a successful block or can it not played
because the vampire is tapped from blocking?

Ex: Theo Bell (7) rushes Gideon (3) and Democritus (10) blocks. Can
Democritus obedience?

Thanks,
Dan

what about WWEF?
Do not replace until your next untap phase. Only usable by a tapped
vampire. This reacting vamipre can use reaction cards and attempt to
block as though untapped until the current action is concluded.

But notice the card never says you untap, thus a tapped vampire can
block in the proper event sequence.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <3b936b04.1157531379@news>, Talo...@hotmail.com writes

>Well I knew that, but I thought there was something about 'blocking'
>on Obedience.

"Only usable when this reacting vampire is about to enter combat with an
acting younger vampire."

The reacting minion does not need to be blocking. Hence Obedience is
defence against rush decks which you aren't blocking.

>I guess that only refers to the acting minion's action
>now being 'blocked'?

"The acting vampire is blocked and cannot attempt the same action this
turn."

This is the only reference to blocking on the card. Obedience itself
blocks the action. (Similar functions occur with Kiss of Ra.)
